reply.emotion: sunlit and warm, looking out at the blue sea
notes: Use "la plage" when talking about going to the seaside to relax on the sand.
It also means a range or scope in technical contexts, such as "une plage de températures".

senses.definition: A flat area of sand or small stones beside the sea or a lake.

examples.text: Nous passons toute la journée sur la plage.
examples.translation: We spend the whole day on the beach.
examples.emotion: relaxed and happy, enjoying a warm sunny day by the water

senses.definition: A range or span between two limits.

examples.text: Le thermomètre affiche une plage de valeurs normale.
examples.translation: The thermometer shows a normal range of values.
examples.emotion: focused and matter-of-fact, checking technical data
